preview_heading: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons vs Guyana Amazon Warriors: a direct route to the final
preview: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons face Guyana Amazon Warriors in CPL 2026 Qualifier 1 at Kensington Oval on September 17. Play starts at 8:00pm Barbados time. The winner advances directly to the final, while the losing team gets another chance in Qualifier 2 against the Eliminator winner.
preview_detail: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons and Guyana Amazon Warriors are confirmed as the Qualifier 1 participants. The toss result and confirmed playing XIs will be added when announced on match day.
